rationale: This is a clear motor-vehicle collision with significant vehicle damage and bodily injury to the policyholder caused by another vehicle's impact.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended at high speed (≈35 mph) on Route 9 and has a totaled vehicle with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance info is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended; other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: Policyholder's vehicle parked in own driveway struck by falling tree; this is comprehensive auto damage covered under the auto policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim (POL-1005) reports a maple tree from their front yard fell in high wind and struck their vehicle parked in the driveway, causing damage to the hood and windshield. Vehicle is covered under a homeowners/auto bundle policy with a $1,000 deductible.

case_facts.description: maple tree from front yard fell in wind and struck parked vehicle
